content:
Nina Park: Quick sync — SkyGrid wants a co-launch next month: marketplace tile + joint tech blog + 30m demo (shorter than usual). Can we run a 2.5 week push?
Raj Patel: Shorter timeline but sounds fine if we lock scope. Prioritize marketplace listing + landing page + single-demo. Blog can be co-authored long-form but publish after launch if needed.
Clara Song: I can do messaging A/B for the hero headline. Two options: "Deploy Redwood on SkyGrid in minutes" vs "Cost-efficient LLM inference on SkyGrid". Need partner input.
Elliot (SkyGrid): We prefer the first variant focused on ease. We'll also provide a customer quote and an architecture SVG.
marketing-ops: For leads, propose mapping registrants -> SFDC Campaign SG-RED-LAUNCH and set owner to partner-sdr-queue. UTM params: utm_source=skygrid&utm_medium=marketplace&utm_campaign=sg_red_launch.
Nina Park: Good. Add cookie window 45d and attribute first-touch. We want to capture partner-sourced demo attendees as closed-loop.
marketing-ops: Noted. I'll set up a zap: form -> HubSpot -> SFDC. Minimal field mapping:
```
email -> lead.Email
company -> lead.AccountName
utm_campaign -> campaign.Name
source -> lead.Source = "skygrid"
```
Raj Patel: Demo plan: 20m live demo (Marcos style) + 5m quick FAQ + 5m CTA. Clara, can you prepare 3 quick talking points for host?
Clara Song: Yep. Also will add an FAQ bullet about model size limitations and expected p99 latency. Keep it clear.
Elliot (SkyGrid): We'll send two engineers for the demo and a short testimonial. Also can we co-brand the registration page?
Nina Park: Yes, co-branding allowed. Design-team, can you produce a co-branded hero + 1 architecture graphic? 1200x675 for hero.
design-team: On it. Deliverables ETA 48h. Need partner logos (svg) with clearspace guidelines.
marketing-ops: Registration fields: name, email, company, role, cloud provider. Add hidden field partner_id=skygrid for attribution.
eng-ml-bouncebot: Quick check: we can supply a 95th percentile latency number from the internal perf harness. If you want a micro-benchmark for the blog, we need 48h to run variants.
Raj Patel: Do the micro-benchmark. If results are noisy, we'll label it "example workload" and include harness details.
Clara Song: For the blog headline test, we'll run variant A (ease) vs B (cost) as an email subject split on the invite list. Track open rate + CTR.
Nina Park: Love it. Who's writing the blog draft? Raj or partner?
Elliot (SkyGrid): We'll draft the technical integration section. Redwood to draft intro + conclusion. Co-edit and aim for one week turnaround.
marketing-ops: Routing note: set lead.Origin = "marketplace" and add campaign tag SG-RED-2026. Also enable Salesforce Campaign auto-add for attendees.
Nina Park: Rehearsal: plan a dry run 3 days before launch. Proposed rehearsal: Tue Apr 27 @ 10am PT.
Elliot (SkyGrid): Works for our crew.
design-team: Sending initial comps tonight.
marketing-ops: I'll post the registration link once landing page is live and confirm UTM plumbing.
Nina Park: Action list recap: design comps + partner logos (48h), eng perf micro-bench (48h), marketplace copy + co-brand assets (72h), registration + zap (24h), blog skeleton (7d). I'll create a follow-up doc in #marketing with deadlines.
Raj Patel: I'll coordinate the rehearsal and host. Clara will run the A/B subject test.
Elliot (SkyGrid): Thanks everyone — excited to ship.
Nina Park: Great. Keep messaging tight and call out any limitations up-front. We'll avoid feature surprises on day 1. :sparkles:
